# DATING SAFETY ON THE FRONTIER [italic]Love is a risk. It should not be a hazard. OreMatch's tips for meeting your match in one piece.[/italic]
## BEFORE YOU MEET - Swap at least three letters. A real person can hold a conversation. A con artist can hold two. - Never send credits over the relay to someone you have not met. If they need money for a ticket, they can save up like everyone else. - Check their colony is real. Some colonies on the tapes are not on any chart. Some charts are wrong. Some colonies have gone quiet since the tape was made.
## WHEN YOU MEET - Meet somewhere public and well lit: a canteen, a spaceport lounge or the Gateway Promenade. - Do not meet in a maintenance tunnel, a lower processor level or anywhere you have to crawl to reach. - Tell a friend where you are going. Tell your Working Joe as well. It will not do anything, but it will remember.
## WARNING SIGNS - Your match says they are on a colony that went quiet and asks you to come and visit. - Your match's tape is very short and very dark. - Your match does not appear in any photograph, including the one they sent you. - Your match has more than one set of jaws. OreMatch has been asked to add this one, and we are not asking why.
## SYNTHETIC MATCHES OreMatch welcomes artificial persons. If your match tells you they are synthetic, thank them for their honesty. If your match tells you they are not synthetic and then picks up a power loader by one corner, ask again.
